issues.title: Toast viewport bottom spacing
issues.description: The bottommost toast container sits flush against the viewport edge without standard inset spacing.
issues.evidence: The red 'Webhook delivery failed' toast reaches the bottom screen border with zero offset.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent bottom padding to the toast container viewport.
issues.triageNote: Verified by live DOM measurement (viewport bottom-0 + p-4 gives exactly 16px inset; destructive toast bottom=884 vs innerHeight=900 at 1440x900) and by pixel analysis of the pair-154 screenshot itself (red toast ends at y=1175 of 1199 → 24 real px = 16 logical px gap; zero red pixels in the bottom 24 rows). The p-4 inset works as designed; 'zero offset' was a perception misread.

fixLog.issue: known-context: destructive variant references text-destructive-foreground, which has no token in globals.css (dangling class → text inherits near-white on bright red bg)
fixLog.triageNote: Confirmed: compiled CSS has no .text-destructive-foreground rule; computed text color rgb(241,239,233) on bg rgb(255,111,99) = 2.37:1 contrast (dark), ~3.1:1 in light — fails AA. Fixed in src/components/ui/toast.tsx by swapping to the defined theme-inverting token text-destructive-50 (light: #fef0ee on #b93a2c ≈ 4.9:1; dark: #36100c on #ff6f63 ≈ 6.2:1) for the toast root, ToastAction hover, and ToastClose destructive icon/ring colors (previously hardcoded red-300/red-50 that collapsed to 1.44:1 on the dark-theme salmon bg).
